reason: A DeepSeek Harness plugin whose primary purpose is persistent cross-session agent memory, using local Markdown storage, semantic retrieval, structured entities, and automatic memory consolidation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话持久记忆、语义检索、结构化信息整理和可编辑的本地 Markdown 存储。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with persistent cross-session memory, semantic retrieval, structured information organization, and editable local Markdown storage.

capabilities: performs semantic search and structured entity extraction
automatically consolidates, deduplicates, merges, and archives memories
stores memories as human-editable Markdown files
